name: Shortcodes
description: Type : and a name for an emoji or an icon, as in Slack or Discord: :fi suggests 🔥, and :fire: typed whole becomes it. Icons go in as :LiCalendar:, Obsidian's Iconize way, and show as the icon.

emoji.label: Emoji
emoji.description: suggest emoji after :, and turn :fire: into 🔥

icons.label: Icons
icons.description: suggest the app's icons too (:icon-calendar), and show :LiCalendar: as the icon
